thread.title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) will release a 13-inch MacBook Air; analyst Ming-Chi Kuo

author: Grant Pasek
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) will release a 13-inch MacBook Air; analyst Ming-Chi Kuo
text:
March 4, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) will release a 13-inch MacBook Air; analyst Ming-Chi Kuo 
According to 9to5Mac, analyst Ming-Chi Kuo expects that Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) will release a 13-inch MacBook Air “with a lower price tag,” later this year, and that the lower price could help boost Apple’s laptop sales. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) hasn’t done much with its ultra-thin MacBook Air in recent years, opting to slim down some of its other offerings instead. But the computer is reasonably popular, and according to Apple analyst KGI Securities, the tech company is reportedly planning to release a cheaper model at some point in the second quarter of 2018. The report also says that Apple will likely refresh its AirPods, and that the HomePod has been met with “mediocre” demand. 
While the line celebrates its tenth year in 2018, the line has largely only received incremental updates, the last of which came last summer, when Apple updated it with a faster 1.8GHz Intel processor. Apple currently sells the MacBook Air for $999.
